meta.name: SRS/SRT fractionation model v3 (MATLAB)
meta.status: Locked model v3 (MATLAB, 2026-11-07). Tested on 24 independent clinical plans at the developing institution (brain-dose MAE 1.1 cm³; recommended scheme = delivered scheme in 24 of 24); not yet validated in other institutions. Research and validation use only.
meta.data_of_record: MASTER_FINAL_v13 (367 atlas plans; OAR cohort 12 patients, 48 distance points)

algorithms.brain: fitrgp ardsquaredexponential, Standardize, inputs [log(volume) central irregular], response log(brain)
algorithms.quality: fitrgp ardsquaredexponential, Standardize, inputs [log(volume) central irregular], response raw
algorithms.oar: fitrensemble Bag 500, MinLeafSize 2, NumVariablesToSample all; inputs [oar_dist chiasm contact_code volume srs24 fr3]

meta.rule: Recommended scheme = the longest of (1) the MTV-table label of the nearest tested volume at or above the target volume, (2) the first scheme whose predicted brain dose is below its limit within its tested volume range, and (3) the OAR rule (>= 10 mm: no restriction; 6 to < 10 mm: no change, check the OAR dose; < 6 mm: point contact SRS 18 Gy, contact < 5 mm one scheme longer than the brain-based scheme, contact > 5 mm five fractions).

oar.split_rule: x >= cut moves to the next interval (MATLAB: x < cut goes left)
